data.name: MWE5_003
data.value: We should set up camp here and rest before the final climb.

data.name: MWE5_004
data.value: Tomorrow, we'll reach Cloven Ruins...[pause=0] assuming the mountain lets us pass.

data.name: MWE5_005
data.value: Alright.[pause=0] Let's rest up and regain our strength.

data.name: MWE5_006
data.value: The summit is closer than it looks, but the wind will not make it easy.

data.name: MWE5_007
data.value: We should stay together. The mountain has already separated us once.

data.name: MWE5_008
data.value: The weather changed before sunset. That is not normal for this route.

data.name: MWE5_009
data.value: If the wind rises again, we stop. No one is proving anything by collapsing.

data.name: MWE5_010
data.value: We crossed the tunnel. We can cross a mountain too.

data.name: MWE5_011
data.value: And if the path changes, we will read it together and find another way.

data.name: MWE5_012
data.value: That is the spirit! We made it this far because nobody stayed behind.

data.name: MWE5_013
data.value: Do not mistake enthusiasm for preparation. Check your supplies before sleeping.

data.name: MWE5_014
data.value: I already checked them twice. I can check them a third time!

data.name: MWE5_015
data.value: Please do. The summit is no place for a careless mistake.

data.name: MWE5_016
data.value: We will be careful. Tomorrow we finish this climb as a team.

data.name: MWE5_017
data.value: The wind is carrying a strange sound from above us.

data.name: MWE5_018
data.value: It may be the ruins. Or the mountain may be warning us away.

data.name: MWE5_019
data.value: Then we listen, remember what we heard, and keep our eyes open.

data.name: MWE5_020
data.value: Tomorrow, we reach the summit.

data.name: MWE5_023
data.value: (Everyone settles around the fire.[pause=15] For once,[pause=10] the wind feels almost gentle.)

data.name: MWE5_024
data.value: Soup's ready![pause=0] Eat it while it's hot![pause=10] Up here, it goes cold in two minutes flat!

data.name: MWE5_025
data.value: ...It's better than what we get at the guild.[pause=10] Repeat that to anyone and I'll deny everything.

data.name: MWE5_026
data.value: I heard that, {0}![pause=0] It's going straight in my recipe book:[pause=10] 'Even grumps ask for seconds.'

data.name: MWE5_027
data.value: It's my first time eating under the open sky![pause=0] Does food always taste different up high?

data.name: MWE5_028
data.value: It's the wind.[pause=10] It sneaks a little cold into everything...[pause=10] even the soup.

data.name: MWE5_029
data.value: Notes, notes...[pause=10] 'Day four:[pause=10] wind speed doubles after sundown.'[pause=0] My almanac is going to be THICK after this expedition.

data.name: MWE5_030
data.value: You're STILL scribbling?[pause=0] Ruff![pause=0] Put the notes down and look up![pause=10] You can see every single star from here!

data.name: MWE5_031
data.value: ...Okay, that goes in the almanac too.[pause=10] 'The sky above {0}:[pause=10] worth the climb all on its own.'

data.name: MWE5_032
data.value: Hrm.[pause=10] Crum keeps snapping at the sparks.[pause=0] Even my tail finds this fire livelier than the guild hearth.

data.name: MWE5_033
data.value: Enjoy it while it lasts![pause=10] Where we're headed tomorrow, you won't find a single twig to burn.

data.name: MWE5_034
data.value: The wind shifted again at dusk.[pause=10] That's the third time today.[pause=0] I don't like what it's carrying, old friend.

data.name: MWE5_035
data.value: Neither do I.[pause=20] But look at them, {0}.[pause=10] Look how far they've come.[pause=0] Whatever the summit sends, we'll weather it together.

data.name: MWE5_036
data.value: ...As you say.[pause=10] I'll take the first watch.[pause=0] These old eyes were made for nights like this one.

data.name: MWE5_037
data.value: Before anyone goes to sleep:[pause=10] paws, scarves, blisters![pause=0] Line up, no exceptions.[pause=10] Yes, {0}, that includes you.

data.name: MWE5_038
data.value: Tch.[pause=10] Fine.[pause=0] But if you tell anyone I let you bandage my toe, I'm leaving you on this mountain.

data.name: MWE5_039
data.value: And THAT is the nicest thing he's said this whole expedition!

data.name: MWE5_040
data.value: {0}...?[pause=10] You're doing it again.[pause=0] Staring up at the summit.[pause=10] Is it that feeling of yours?

data.name: MWE5_041
data.value: It's stronger up here.[pause=10] Like the mountain is...[pause=10] humming.[pause=0] I can't explain it better than that.

data.name: MWE5_042
data.value: Then we'll figure it out together, up there.[pause=0] Whatever it is,[pause=10] we face it as a team.[pause=10] Right?

data.name: MWE5_043
data.value: Right.[pause=10] As a team.

data.name: MWE5_044
data.value: All right, everyone![pause=10] Tomorrow we make the final climb,[pause=10] and {0} will test every single one of us.

data.name: MWE5_045
data.value: So tonight, your only mission is to SLEEP![pause=0] That's a Guildmaster's order...[pause=10] and the easiest one I will ever give!

data.name: MWE5_046
data.value: You heard the Guildmaster![pause=0] Last one asleep does the breakfast dishes!

data.name: MWE5_047
data.value: Psst...[pause=10] {0}.[pause=0] First one to the summit tomorrow wins the other's dessert ration.[pause=10] Ruff.

data.name: MWE5_048
data.value: Deal.[pause=10] 'Day four, addendum:[pause=10] struck an excellent bargain.'[pause=20] ...Good night, {0}.

data.name: MWE5_049
data.value: Good night, {0}.[pause=20] Tomorrow...[pause=10] the summit.[pause=0] I can hardly believe we're really here.

data.name: MWE5_050
data.value: (Eleven sets of breathing around one fire.[pause=20] The mountain hums...[pause=10] but this sound is louder.[pause=10] In the best way.)

data.name: MWE5_051
data.value: (The fire wanes.[pause=15] One by one,[pause=10] the camp falls asleep...[pause=15] and the mountain,[pause=10] patient,[pause=10] waits.)

data.name: MWE5_052
data.value: The next morning...

data.name: MWE5_053
data.value: Rise and shine, everyone![pause=0] It's summit day!

data.name: MWE5_054
data.value: Full stretches, full breakfasts, full waterskins![pause=10] This morning, MY orders come even before the Guildmaster's!

data.name: MWE5_055
data.value: ...{0}.[pause=20] Again.

data.name: MWE5_056
data.value: Our dungeon expert is about to sleep straight through the dungeon.

data.name: MWE5_057
data.value: {0}!!![pause=0] The summit is TODAY!!!

data.name: MWE5_058
data.value: Mrrgh...[pause=20] five more minutes...[pause=10] the mountain's not going anywhere...

data.name: MWE5_059
data.value: No, but the expedition IS.[pause=20] Honestly...[pause=10] every single camp, without fail.

data.name: MWE5_060
data.value: Pff...[pause=10] at least some things never change,[pause=10] even on a mountain.

data.name: MWE5_061
data.value: Good morning, Pokémon![pause=0] I trust everyone is rested,[pause=10] thanks to {0}'s...[pause=10] spirited assistance!

data.name: MWE5_062
data.value: Today, we climb {0} itself.[pause=10] Beyond it lie {1},[pause=10] our goal,[pause=10] and the end of this expedition.

data.name: MWE5_063
data.value: {0}![pause=10] Now that you are finally AWAKE,[pause=10] would you tell us what the mountain has in store?

data.name: MWE5_064
data.value: Heh...[pause=10] sorry, sorry.[pause=0] Listen close,[pause=10] because up there the wind won't let you hear anything twice!

data.name: MWE5_065
data.value: The gusts come in waves.[pause=10] When one hits, it can shove you clean off the path.[pause=0] So plant your feet[pause=10] and WAIT it out.

data.name: MWE5_066
data.value: And keep the formation tight.[pause=10] If the wind splits us up like the steppe did,[pause=10] don't wander:[pause=10] the paths up there shift like any mystery dungeon.

data.name: MWE5_067
data.value: I will fly ahead where the winds allow.[pause=10] If you hear my call above the gale,[pause=10] it means the way is clear.

data.name: MWE5_068
data.value: You have all carried this expedition further than I dared hope.[pause=20] One last climb, everyone!

data.name: MWE5_069
data.value: For the guild,[pause=10] and for each other![pause=0] Let's show this mountain what we're made of!

data.name: MWE5_070
data.value: Yeah!!!

data.name: MWE5_201
data.value: Crunch-munch! Om-nom-nom! Chomp-chomp!\nCrunch-munch! Om-nom-nom! Chomp-chomp!

data.name: MWE5_072
data.value: (Bags open,[pause=10] bedrolls unfold around the fire.[pause=15] One for each — except Phileas,[pause=10] on watch.)

data.name: MWE5_073
data.value: (Night falls on the mountain for good.)

data.name: MWE5_074
data.value: ...You know,[pause=10] if the summit scares you...[pause=10] it scares me a little too.

data.name: MWE5_075
data.value: But we crossed the steppe.[pause=10] We crossed the tunnel.[pause=0] Tomorrow, we write the ending together.

data.name: MWE5_082
data.value: Climb.[pause=20] The wind remembers you,[pause=10] even if you remember nothing.

data.name: MWE5_084
data.value: ...We have met before,[pause=10] little echo.

data.name: MWE5_085
data.value: (A shadow...[pause=20] It spoke as if it knew me.[pause=20] « Little echo »...[pause=10] What does that mean?)

data.name: MWE5_086
data.value: (The wind is still blowing.[pause=10] No one else heard it...[pause=20] I need to sleep.[pause=10] Tomorrow,[pause=10] the summit.)

data.name: MWE5_087
data.value: ...{0}?[pause=10] You're all pale.[pause=0] Did you sleep badly?

data.name: MWE5_088
data.value: (...The dream.[pause=10] I can still hear its voice.)[pause=20] ...I'm fine.[pause=10] Just...[pause=10] a strange night.

data.name: MWE5_089
data.value: Assembly![pause=0] Ranks of two,[pause=10] just like at the guild![pause=0] The summit will not wait for stragglers!

data.name: MWE5_092
data.value: The steppe taught us that a large team protects.[pause=10] The tunnel,[pause=10] that it advances.[pause=0] But the mountain...[pause=20] the mountain DIVIDES.

data.name: MWE5_093
data.value: So today,[pause=10] no large teams.[pause=0] We climb in ROPE TEAMS,[pause=10] by role.[pause=0] Small,[pause=10] tight,[pause=10] and each one complete.

data.name: MWE5_094
data.value: Lead rope team:[pause=10] {0},[pause=10] {1}[pause=10] and {2}.[pause=0] You read the terrain and you mark the path.

data.name: MWE5_095
data.value: Count on us![pause=0] Nobody reads a dungeon like I do...[pause=20] when I'm awake.

data.name: MWE5_096
data.value: Support rope team:[pause=10] {0}[pause=10] and {1}.[pause=0] Healing,[pause=10] provisions,[pause=10] and an eye on our backs.

data.name: MWE5_097
data.value: No one climbs on an empty stomach,[pause=10] that's a promise!

data.name: MWE5_098
data.value: Summit rope team:[pause=10] {0},[pause=10] {1},[pause=10] {2}[pause=10] and {3}.[pause=0] You carry our banner to the top.

data.name: MWE5_099
data.value: The summit rope team?![pause=0] We won't let you down...[pause=10] right,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: MWE5_100
data.value: Hmph.[pause=20] Just try to keep up with my pace.

data.name: MWE5_101
data.value: {0} and I will hold the base camp.[pause=10] The winds up there carry me poorly,[pause=10] and someone must keep the relay and watch for signals.

data.name: MWE5_102
data.value: If the weather turns,[pause=10] I will fly up to warn you.[pause=0] Listen to the sky.

data.name: MWE5_103
data.value: Rope teams of Mount Windswept...[pause=20] move out![pause=0] And come back to me,[pause=10] ALL of you!

data.name: MWE5_105
data.value: First rope team,[pause=10] with me![pause=0] The wind is waiting!

data.name: MWE5_106
data.value: We'll keep a warm meal for you at the relay!

data.name: MWE5_107
data.value: ...{0}.[pause=20] You've been staring at the summit like it called your name last night.[pause=10] ...Did something happen?

data.name: MWE5_108
data.value: (Tell them?[pause=10] ...Not yet.[pause=10] Not while I don't understand it myself.)[pause=20] ...I'll tell you up there.[pause=10] Promise.

data.name: MWE5_109
data.value: ...Alright.[pause=10] Up there.[pause=0] I WILL remind you!

data.name: MWE5_110
data.value: There you are.[pause=10] The rope teams are away.[pause=0] Yours closes the march.

data.name: MWE5_111
data.value: ...Long ago,[pause=10] I left something on this mountain.[pause=20] Today it gives something back:[pause=10] an entire guild,[pause=10] standing at its gates.

data.name: MWE5_112
data.value: The wind is honest this morning.[pause=10] That is rare.[pause=0] Take it as a good omen.

data.name: MWE5_113
data.value: {0},[pause=10] {1}...[pause=10] Ganlon and Shuca await you at the first ledge.[pause=0] When you are ready,[pause=10] climb.[pause=0] And remember...

data.name: MWE5_114
data.value: ...one does not conquer a mountain.[pause=20] One pays it a visit.[pause=0] Knock on its door with respect.

data.name: MWE5_115
data.value: We're all coming back.[pause=10] That's a promise from the summit rope team!

data.name: MWE5_120
data.value: There they are![pause=0] Quick,[pause=10] {0}![pause=0] They're down!

data.name: MWE5_121
data.value: Breathe...[pause=20] there.[pause=0] The wind beat you,[pause=10] it didn't break you.

data.name: MWE5_122
data.value: The summit...[pause=20] we were so close...

data.name: MWE5_123
data.value: The mountain does not count attempts.[pause=20] It only remembers those who climb back up.

data.name: MWE5_124
data.value: Regain your strength.[pause=10] Emergency provisions —[pause=10] this is exactly what they are for.

data.name: MWE5_125
data.value: When you are ready,[pause=10] the path will still be there.[pause=0] And so will we.

data.name: MWE5_126
data.value: You came back down?[pause=10] A wise call.[pause=0] In the mountains,[pause=10] a step back is not a defeat.

data.name: MWE5_127
data.value: The wind will turn.[pause=10] Rest,[pause=10] then attempt the climb again.

data.name: MWE5_104
data.value: We'll go ahead and mark the rope![pause=0] See you at the first ledge,[pause=10] you two!

data.name: MWE5_116
data.value: Not you, {0}.[pause=20] You hold the base camp with us.[pause=0] That is an order...[pause=10] and a promise I keep.

data.name: MWE5_117
data.value: ...Yes, Master.[pause=20] But one day you will tell me why.

data.name: MWE5_156
data.value: (A dream?[pause=30] I can't even remember it any more.)

data.name: MWE5_157
data.value: (There was someone.[pause=20] Someone speaking to me...[pause=30] and that's all that's left.)

data.name: MWE5_158
data.value: (They look like they're having a serious discussion...)

data.name: MWE5_159
data.value: ...No. No, no, no.[pause=20] I refuse to let that one slide.

data.name: MWE5_160
data.value: It's a matter of PRINCIPLE at this point.

data.name: MWE5_161
data.value: The fate of the expedition may depend on it.[pause=20] Think carefully.

data.name: MWE5_162
data.value: So.[pause=20] One Oran Berry a day for a year...[pause=30] or ONE Perfect Apple, just once?

data.name: MWE5_163
data.value: ...[pause=30] THAT's your serious discussion?

data.name: MWE5_164
data.value: They've been at it for an hour, woof.

data.name: MWE5_165
data.value: The Perfect Apple, obviously.[pause=0] You only live once.

data.name: MWE5_166
data.value: Wrong![pause=20] Three hundred and sixty-five berries is three hundred and sixty-five happy mornings.

data.name: MWE5_167
data.value: ...You did the maths?[pause=30] You ACTUALLY did the maths?

data.name: MWE5_168
data.value: Of course I did.[pause=0] I don't debate lightly.

data.name: MWE5_169
data.value: Hmm.[pause=30] The Perfect Apple, no question.

data.name: MWE5_170
data.value: THANK YOU![pause=0] The Guildmaster has spoken!

data.name: MWE5_171
data.value: (...He answered instantly.[pause=20] He'd already thought about it.)

data.name: MWE5_172
data.value: There you are![pause=20] I've been watching that trail all evening.

data.name: MWE5_173
data.value: Nine hours late.[pause=20] I counted three times.

data.name: MWE5_174
data.value: YOU'RE ALIVE![pause=15] I knew it![pause=10] Well,[pause=10] I hoped.

data.name: MWE5_175
data.value: Sit down.[pause=15] I'm checking your wounds before you say a word.

data.name: MWE5_176
data.value: There's soup left.[pause=20] It's gone cold three times,[pause=10] but it's there.

data.name: MWE5_177
data.value: 'Not too late'...[pause=25] We finished eating two hours ago.

data.name: MWE5_178
data.value: The wind turned at dusk.[pause=20] That's why they took so long.

data.name: MWE5_181
data.value: Hey,[pause=10] you big losers![pause=20] We're not waiting around all day!

data.name: MWE5_182
data.value: ...What did you just say?

data.name: MWE5_183
data.value: I said...[pause=30] what a magnificent view,[pause=15] and we should enjoy it.

data.name: MWE5_184
data.value: That's what I thought.

data.name: MWE5_185
data.value: (...I think we just witnessed a rescue.)

data.name: MWE5_186
data.value: MASTER![pause=20] They're back,[pause=10] but they can't stand up!

data.name: MWE5_187
data.value: Move aside,[pause=10] give them room![pause=20] There,[pause=10] just breathe.

data.name: MWE5_188
data.value: Easy now.[pause=20] Nobody gets up all at once,[pause=10] and nobody has to.

data.name: MWE5_189
data.value: Here.[pause=20] An Oran Berry.[pause=10] Eat it before you say a word.

data.name: MWE5_190
data.value: There.[pause=30] Some colour coming back.[pause=10] That's a start.

data.name: MWE5_191
data.value: I can run fast and bite hard.[pause=20] Healing,[pause=10] that's not in my paws.

data.name: MWE5_192
data.value: Next time,[pause=10] I'm climbing with you.[pause=20] Then there'll be nothing to patch up.

data.name: MWE5_193
data.value: Hoo...[pause=20] You sat up all at once.[pause=15] I heard it from over there.

data.name: MWE5_194
data.value: Don't say anything yet.[pause=20] Breathe first.[pause=15] The words will come after.

data.name: MWE5_195
data.value: A dream,[pause=10] wasn't it?[pause=25] The kind you forget on waking,[pause=15] but that leaves the heart racing.

data.name: MWE5_196
data.value: (...He guessed.[pause=25] Or it's written on my face.)

data.name: MWE5_197
data.value: I've kept watch many a mountain night.[pause=25] They make sleep talkative,[pause=15] and dreams insistent.

data.name: MWE5_198
data.value: Go back to sleep.[pause=20] I'll stay awake.[pause=25] As long as someone keeps watch,[pause=15] no one wakes alone.

data.name: MWE5_202
data.value: Hey![pause=10] We brought the water![pause=20] Guess who carried it![pause=15] Hint:[pause=10] not me.

data.name: MWE5_203
data.value: Hmf.[pause=10] A full jug the whole trail up...[pause=15] And not a single thank-you.

data.name: MWE5_204
data.value: Survey complete.[pause=15] The summit trail is walkable — three quarters of it.

data.name: MWE5_205
data.value: You're here at last.[pause=15] The wind didn't get you — nor did the lava.

data.name: MWE5_206
data.value: Let me count...[pause=10] no scrapes?[pause=15] Good.[pause=20] Very good.

data.name: MWE5_207
data.value: The stew is hot ONLY because I've been watching it all day.

data.name: MWE5_208
data.value: Me?[pause=10] I followed a light![pause=15] ...Fine,[pause=10] a firefly.[pause=10] Long story.

data.name: MWE5_209
data.value: Following the stew's smell:[pause=10] that's my navigation.[pause=15] It never fails.

data.name: MWE5_210
data.value: Lost?[pause=10] Us?[pause=15] We took STRATEGIC detours,[pause=10] that's different.

data.name: MWE5_211
data.value: I cut across the ridges.[pause=15] Shorter,[pause=10] quieter.[pause=15] Old caravan habits.

data.name: MWE5_212
data.value: All logged in the journal:[pause=10] 47 bends,[pause=10] 2 rockslides,[pause=10] 1 rescue.

data.name: MWE5_213
data.value: I barked REALLY loud,[pause=10] and someone found me.[pause=15] Reliable system![pause=0] Woof!

data.name: MWE5_214
data.value: My method:[pause=10] markers every twelve steps,[pause=10] cross-checked notes.[pause=15] Zero errors.

data.name: MWE5_215
data.value: The dungeon shifts with every trip.[pause=15] Each of you found YOUR way — and you all made it.

data.name: MWE5_216
data.value: (Eleven ways to reach camp,[pause=10] zero plan,[pause=10] hundred percent success.[pause=15] What a guild.)

data.name: MWE5_217
data.value: Well.[pause=10] Since everyone is here,[pause=10] Pokemon —[pause=15] it is time for dinner.

data.name: MWE5_218
data.value: Hm?[pause=15] What?![pause=20] WHY is everyone looking at me?!

data.name: MWE5_219
data.value: Because "dinner" is the only word you ever hear,[pause=10] you big glutton.

data.name: MWE5_220
data.value: I...[pause=15] I can't anymore...[pause=20] My feet won't even answer!

data.name: MWE5_221
data.value: You could have WAITED for me![pause=15] Not even a glance back!

data.name: MWE5_222
data.value: At Metano,[pause=10] I was bored to death...[pause=15] So I trained,[pause=10] again and again...

data.name: MWE5_223
data.value: ...and I decided to FOLLOW you.[pause=20] Lost sight of you at the first bend.[pause=10] Both of you.

data.name: MWE5_224
data.value: The Tunnel,[pause=10] I ran through it THREE TIMES![pause=20] THREE![pause=0] Get that into your heads!

data.name: MWE5_225
data.value: (She crossed the Searing Tunnel...[pause=10] alone...?[pause=15] For US?!)

data.name: MWE5_226
data.value: Crossing a dungeon alone is no small thing,[pause=10] little one.[pause=15] You're one of us.

data.name: MWE5_227
data.value: Sit,[pause=10] eat,[pause=10] BREATHE.[pause=15] In that order.

data.name: MWE5_228
data.value: Five plates![pause=15] ...What?[pause=10] You run with LEGS.[pause=10] I have FEET.

data.name: MWE5_229
data.value: ...At night,[pause=10] the mountain ANSWERS your call...[pause=15] with YOUR voice,[pause=10] one beat late.

data.name: MWE5_230
data.value: I know worse:[pause=10] the lantern that climbs the trail alone...[pause=15] and you must NEVER follow it.

data.name: MWE5_231
data.value: Mhm...[pause=15] And the traveler who shows you the way in a dream...[pause=20] and that dawn erases.

data.name: MWE5_232
data.value: (Thanks,[pause=10] everyone.[pause=15] I'm never sleeping tonight.)

data.name: MWE5_233
data.value: LITTLE RASCALS![pause=10] Bed,[pause=10] immediately![pause=15] Take example on Kino,[pause=10] at least he—

data.name: MWE5_234
data.value: (...Kino's been asleep for ten minutes,[pause=10] Phileas.[pause=15] Sound asleep,[pause=10] at that.)

data.name: MWE5_235
data.value: ...Fine.[pause=15] Sleep.[pause=10] Like.[pause=10] Kino.[pause=15] That's an order.

data.name: MWE5_236
data.value: ...and they bought it![pause=15] "Lava?[pause=10] Reassuring!"[pause=15] Ha!

data.name: MWE5_237
data.value: Kino.[pause=20] One day,[pause=10] your stories will catch up with you.

data.name: MWE5_238
data.value: (Those two could do without us all evening.)
